summary: Regen tank who's weak at levels 1–3 and nearly unkillable once he has HP items and R. He pokes with cleavers and runs through CC. The plan against him: bully him early, buy anti-heal, and use %HP or true damage.
threats: Q (Infected Bonesaw) deals %current-HP damage and slows; it's his main poke and last-hit tool.
His passive lets him ignore the first CC in a fight. Don't open with your stun; bait the canister first.
E (Blunt Force Trauma) gets stronger the lower his HP is, so he hits harder when you've poked him down.
R (Maximum Dosage) at 5 gives huge regen and speed; he heals back to full from low HP.

matchups.why: Vayne's W (Silver Bolts) deals true %max-HP damage, so Mundo's HP stacking makes him more vulnerable, not less. She out-ranges him and kites his run-ins, and he has no gap closer besides walking.
trading: Auto him whenever he walks up to farm; three hits procs Silver Bolts.
Sidestep his Q cleaver by walking behind minions or Tumbling (Q) sideways.
Don't open with Condemn; his passive canister ignores the first CC.
Back off when he activates R; kite him until it ends.
matchups.early: Kite and farm. He can't reach you, and every trade adds up to true damage.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R heals him through your poke; don't chase, wait for it to end.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates while he can't contest.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without R. Gank when it's down.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. Crit and on-hit; an early anti-heal item.

matchups.why: Gwen's damage is magic and %max HP, so Mundo's HP stacking feeds her. W (Hallowed Mist) blocks his Q poke from outside the mist, and she out-trades him in extended fights.
trading: Stack Q with autos, then land the centre of the final snip for true damage.
Pop W when he throws Q to block the cleaver.
E (Skip 'n Slash) to close distance and stick to him.
Don't open with CC; his passive ignores the first one.
matchups.early: Trade with full-stack Q and back off before his E damage climbs.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R heals him back to full; your R lets you keep pressure from range.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade when the wave is with you.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without R. Gank when it's down.
matchups.build: Conqueror. AP bruiser items with %HP damage; anti-heal.

matchups.why: Darius out-damages Mundo at levels 1–3 before his HP items, and Hemorrhage stacks plus Q healing win every extended fight early. Mundo's R heal is easier to beat with anti-heal from your build.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him when he walks up to Q a minion.
Stack Hemorrhage with W and autos; he can't trade back early.
Hit the outer edge of Q on him for damage and healing.
Don't R him while his R is active; wait for it to end.
matchups.early: Bully him at levels 1–3 and deny farm; he's at his weakest here.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R regen out-heals your bleed. Back off during it and execute once it ends.
matchups.wave: Freeze near your tower so he has to walk up to farm.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without R. Gank when it's down.

matchups.why: Tank vs tank: Malphite's Q poke chips Mundo, but Mundo's regen undoes it. Neither can kill the other alone, so the lane is decided by who roams and teamfights better.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him when he walks up to farm.
Stand behind minions to block his Q cleaver.
Don't trade long; he out-sustains you.
Use E (Ground Slam) to slow his attack speed if he trades.
matchups.early: Farm and Q poke. Neither of you can kill the other alone, so don't waste HP.
matchups.spike: At 5 both of you can roam; ward river and track where his R regen takes him.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and roam once your R is up; he can't follow quickly.
matchups.jungle: Your R plus your jungler kills him once his R is down.
